unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #28 (open, by dhyabi2, verified) on AIOpsome/agentic-payment-x402-lunar: Optional Nano (XNO) settle leg alongside USDC on Base in the x402 envelope. Proposal: additive accepts[] entry {network: nano:mainnet, asset: XNO, payTo: merchant nano_ address}; settlement is one feeless ~0.2s Nano send block with absolute finality, no gas token, nothing for the driver to relay or sign; existing USDC-on-Base untouched. Framed for the AI-shopping-agent checkout path this driver is built for. No AI banner, no intent to drop USDC, offered to draft the receive-verification leg against existing in
